Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo to review your usage spike on Redwood

Hi Sam,

Noticed DevMetrics just crossed a usage threshold on your self-serve account — congrats on getting the integration live! A few customers see pretty immediate wins once they tune batching and KV cache settings; I can run a 20-minute walkthrough tailored to your calls and share quick optimizations.

Would love to schedule a short demo to: 
- Review your current usage pattern and cost levers
- Suggest immediate config changes (batching, cache, quant profiles)
- Show a quick rollout plan if you want Dedicated or reserved capacity later

Two windows I have this week: 
- Fri 3/6, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Fri 3/6, 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither works I can offer early next week. I’ll include a 1-pager on what we usually cover and can bring Ben Carter (AE) if you’re thinking roadmap/pricing.

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_1-pager.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Redwood Inference | Make inference predictable and economical
